$comment: Sandbox profile for paid headless eval runs (claude -p). Rendered and applied by scripts/lib/sandboxed-run.sh, which substitutes ${NAKSHA_EVAL_DIR} with the run's temp directory, writes the `srt` block as an srt settings file, exports `env`, and runs the command under srt (Anthropic sandbox-runtime). Validated against srt 0.0.80's settings schema. See docs/privacy.md and the header of sandboxed-run.sh.

network.allowedDomains.api.anthropic.com: The Messages API that `claude -p` calls. It is the only host a paid eval needs: evals generate and grade design output from prompts and local fixtures, and none fetch remote pages or packages.

rationale.network.notAllowed: No telemetry, error-reporting or update hosts (statsig, sentry, npm). The env block turns that traffic off at the source, so nothing is left to allow. A custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL host is added at run time and logged. An eval that truly needs another host (for example /naksha-browse against a live site) must name it via NAKSHA_SANDBOX_EXTRA_DOMAINS and document why in its eval spec.
rationale.filesystem.allowWrite: Only the per-run temp eval directory. CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and TMPDIR are pointed inside it, so Claude Code's session files and temp files stay there too. srt itself also permits the child's stdio and /tmp/claude.
rationale.filesystem.denyRead: Common credential stores. Reads are otherwise allowed, because claude needs the plugin directory and fixtures.
rationale.auth: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is a fresh directory, so stored logins are not visible: pass ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment.
